description: Symbolicate Apple crash artifacts with matching dSYM UUIDs. This debug namespace is intentionally narrow: use logs for app logs, network for HTTP evidence, perf for performance samples, record/trace for media and traces, and react-devtools for React Native components and render profiles. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

out.description: Output path for the symbolicated artifact.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

searchPath.description: Directory to scan for matching .dSYM bundles.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: debug
